params.developerInstructions: R0.5B11 local no-provider preflight; no turn is permitted.

dynamicTools.description: Read the currently authorized Task, its public validation binding, current workspace metadata, handover context and tool budget.
dynamicTools.name: polis_work_current

dynamicTools.description: Read approved context and persisted facts and decisions available to the current worker session.
dynamicTools.name: polis_context_read

dynamicTools.description: Read the full content, digest and revision of the current authorized Task workspace.
dynamicTools.name: polis_workspace_read

dynamicTools.description: Replace the full content of the current authorized Task workspace using its expected digest and revision. The current worker session is the only writer; stale digest or revision returns a conflict and success returns the persisted receipt and new revision.
dynamicTools.name: polis_workspace_replace

dynamicTools.description: Validate the current authorized Task workspace against the public acceptance contract bound to this Task. A PASS receipt proves only that the current workspace meets the public criteria; use task_submit to explicitly deliver it. Returns structured PASS, FAIL, VALIDATION_NOT_CONFIGURED, VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE or INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR feedback.
dynamicTools.name: polis_workspace_check

dynamicTools.description: Persist progress or qualified state for the current Task. For a qualified checkpoint, use rejected: [] when no evidence was rejected and set evidence_refs to one or more typed {receipt_id, proves} objects for current workspace_check PASS receipts. task_submit deterministically creates the final qualified checkpoint; progress checkpoints require next_action.

evidence_refs.description: Each reference must be a current workspace_check PASS receipt for this Task/session/workspace.

proves.description: This receipt proves the current workspace passed the public Task validation.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID returned by workspace_check in the current worker session.

kind.description: qualified publishes after validation; progress preserves incomplete work

next_action.description: Required and non-empty for progress checkpoints.

rejected.description: Use [] when no evidence was rejected.

dynamicTools.name: polis_work_checkpoint

dynamicTools.description: Explicitly submit the current authorized workspace after validation PASS. The control plane deterministically creates the qualified checkpoint, publishes the validated Artifact, and moves the Task to candidate; do not assemble checkpoint or Artifact fields yourself.
dynamicTools.name: polis_task_submit
